title: nutriapp-lib consuming-chart values contract
description: Copy this file to a consuming service chart's own values.schema.json (see README.md) so `helm lint`/`helm install` enforce it against that chart's OWN top-level values.yaml. Deliberately named *.template, not values.schema.json, in THIS directory: if a library chart ships its own values.schema.json, Helm additionally (and unavoidably) validates it against the parent's values namespaced under the dependency's alias (here, a `nutriapp-lib:` key) every time any consuming chart declares this as a `dependencies:` entry — which is empty/undefined in this project's convention (named templates are invoked with the consumer's full top-level `.` context, not a subchart-scoped one), so that cascade always fails with confusing 'irsaRoleArn is required' etc. errors unrelated to the consumer's actual (valid) values. Verified empirically against a throwaway test-harness chart during /implementation-execution — see the _lib README's validation section.

tag.description: Must be a git SHA, never the literal 'latest' (docs/containerization-and-orchestration.md section 1).

resources.description: Every container must declare both requests and limits — .claude/skills/containerization/SKILL.md.

irsaRoleArn.description: IRSA role ARN annotation (ADR-0007) — required, no default.
